verdict.rationale: Column documents API keys that must be scoped to sandbox or live mode, with the mode fixed once created. It also offers Custom Roles that give granular access down to specific bank accounts and transfer types. However, the evidence does not explicitly say these roles can be attached to API keys rather than dashboard users, so least-privilege scoping of agent credentials is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit per-API-key permission/role scoping, agent-specific credential issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
